title: MCP 服务变更通知被静默吞掉

history.evidence: Diff replaces response-first deserialization with mutually exclusive envelope dispatch; JsonRpcResponse optional fields previously accepted notification JSON. Standard and legacy method aliases were fixed together.

problem_zh: 连接中的 MCP 服务发出工具、资源或提示列表变更通知后，客户端始终没有更新；普通请求却仍能得到响应。请沿消息接收、解析和事件分发链定位问题，兼容标准通知及已有历史通知格式，同时保证普通响应仍能完成等待中的请求。
test_scope: Direct compilation of complete production Rust modules through #[path]; unrelated learner-profile dependency panics if invoked. No production function is copied.
